kitEvidence.formula:
Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that deals [(6 / 6.5 / 7 / 7.5 / 8 + (0.03) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage, Slows by [0.3] for [1.5] seconds and marks champions and monsters for [4] seconds. Marked enemies continuously Awaken nearby graves (but not exceeding the maximum of @Spell.YorickPassive:YorickPassiveGhoulMax@) and suffer [(0.13 / 0.16 / 0.19 / 0.22 / 0.25) × 100]% reduced Armor.

Yorick and his summoned units gain [(0.18 / 0.21 / 0.24 / 0.27 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed toward the mark. Mist Walkers will leap once at marked enemies that get away from them.

builds.name: Last Rites: missing-health self-heal
builds.summary: Investigate high one champion-hit Last Rites self-heal output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one champion-hit Last Rites self-heal output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Q restores a level-breakpoint base plus 6/7/8/9/10% of Yorick missing HP, with reduced healing against non-champions. More own maximum HP at the same low current-health percentage can enlarge the missing-health term. This helper has no direct AP coefficient; purchased AP is not automatically heal scaling.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 10%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected; no free permanent stacks. Stop observed damage scoring on death, cap observed healing at missing HP, and report raw output separately. Exactly 500 earned Heartsteel HP, owner at 10% health, one Q attack on a champion. Record actual owner maximum HP and missing HP immediately before the heal. Dawncore conversion and Visage are read from actual items. No prior Q heal, item active, lifesteal or allied heal included.

kitEvidence.formula:
Yorick's next Attack deals an additional [30 / 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 + (0.5) × AD] physical damage and restores [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=10, perLevel=2, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] plus [6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10]% of his missing Health, reduced by [50]% against non-Champions. If this Attack hits a Champion or large Monster or kills the target, it leaves a grave.

When there are 3 or more graves nearby and this Ability has already been used, Yorick can Recast to raise Mist Walkers from all nearby graves.
